metadata.title: Application Data Handling

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring applications access, process, and expose data in accordance with purpose, classification, and policy.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application-level data access logic, transformation pipelines, output generation, and data exposure mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing how applications use, transform, and expose data.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Application data handling assumes baseline application identity, purpose, and lifecycle governance.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Data handling decisions depend on correct authorization enforcement.

metadata.remarks: Application Data Handling defines trust properties required to ensure applications use and expose data responsibly. This pattern addresses purpose limitation, overexposure, unsafe transformation, and secondary use risk, without addressing data storage or transport mechanisms.

components.title: Purpose-Limited Data Access
components.description: Ensures applications access only data necessary to fulfill their defined purpose.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or use of data beyond the intended application purpose.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement constraining data access to declared purpose.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define and constrain application data use by purpose.
Least privilege is applied to application data access.

components.title: Data Transformation and Derivative Risk
components.description: Manages risks introduced when applications transform, enrich, or derive new data.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or misuse of transformed data to produce misleading or harmful outputs.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle and validation controls over derived data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms validate correctness of transformed data.

components.title: Data Exposure and Output Control
components.description: Prevents unnecessary or inappropriate exposure of data in application outputs.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of sensitive data through application responses or outputs.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Output filtering and minimization to reduce overexposure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls reduce risk of inappropriate data exposure by applications.

components.title: Data Handling Observability and Audit
components.description: Provides visibility into data access, transformation, and exposure decisions made by applications.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to inappropriate data handling.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging of data handling activities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application data access and output events are logged.
Audit review supports investigation of application data misuse.
